symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$, where $h$ is the number of elements of the ground set.

symbols.name: three-element subsets
symbols.meaning: The set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, which index the banks.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and write $v=\binom{h}{3}$ for the number of its elements.

symbols.name: triple count
symbols.meaning: The number of three-element subsets of $[h]$, which is the number of values varied at each stage.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and write $v=\binom{h}{3}$ for the number of its elements.

symbols.name: bank index
symbols.meaning: A triple of three-element subsets that indexes the two banks.
symbols.quote: Two data banks $X_a$ and $Y_a$ are indexed by $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\in\mathcal T^3$.

symbols.name: first bank
symbols.meaning: The data bank of values indexed by $a$ that the exchange moves to $Y_a$ and back.
symbols.quote: Two data banks $X_a$ and $Y_a$ are indexed by $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\in\mathcal T^3$.

symbols.name: second bank
symbols.meaning: The data bank of values indexed by $a$ that the exchange moves to $X_a$ and back.
symbols.quote: Two data banks $X_a$ and $Y_a$ are indexed by $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\in\mathcal T^3$.

symbols.name: control value
symbols.meaning: The control value at the varying coordinate $T$.
symbols.quote: Let $S,T\in\mathcal T$ be the varying coordinates of a forward invocation, which takes controls $x_T$ and targets $y_S$.

symbols.name: target value
symbols.meaning: The target value at the varying coordinate $S$, which the invocation updates.
symbols.quote: Let $S,T\in\mathcal T$ be the varying coordinates of a forward invocation, which takes controls $x_T$ and targets $y_S$.

symbols.name: varying coordinate
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset that is the varying coordinate of the target.
symbols.quote: Let $S,T\in\mathcal T$ be the varying coordinates of a forward invocation, which takes controls $x_T$ and targets $y_S$.

symbols.name: varying coordinate
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of $[h]$, the varying coordinate of the control.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and write $v=\binom{h}{3}$ for the number of its elements.

symbols.name: neighbor scratch wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire for the neighboring ordered pair $(S,T)$.
symbols.quote: For each neighboring ordered pair $(S,T)$ there is a scratch wire $A_{ST}$, and for each $i\in[h]$ a central wire $C_i$.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For each neighboring ordered pair $(S,T)$ there is a scratch wire $A_{ST}$, and for each $i\in[h]$ a central wire $C_i$.

symbols.name: central scratch wire
symbols.meaning: The central scratch wire for the element $i$ of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For each neighboring ordered pair $(S,T)$ there is a scratch wire $A_{ST}$, and for each $i\in[h]$ a central wire $C_i$.

symbols.name: initial side values
symbols.meaning: The initial values held on the side scratch wires $A_{ST}$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ and $q$ be the initial values of the $A_{ST}$ and $C_i$.

symbols.name: initial central values
symbols.meaning: The initial values held on the central scratch wires $C_i$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ and $q$ be the initial values of the $A_{ST}$ and $C_i$.

relations.quote: The network is a linear operator in [Linear algebra over a field](linear-algebra.md).
It has the fixed structure of a [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-machine.md): a fixed set of wires and a schedule that does not depend on the values it carries.
